title: Copper, But Better
description: What copper was supposed to look like.
body:
One day, I opened Minecraft, genuinely excited to see the new copper armor. I looked at it once… and my brain immediately went “brother eww. eww.”

I leaned in closer (while trying not to vomit) and quickly realized the real problem: no noise.
The copper armor and tools were painfully plain—flat, lifeless, and way too clean. Copper is supposed to look rough, textured, imperfect. This looked like orange plastic.

So I did what had to be done.

I added noise. Nothing crazy, nothing overdesigned—just enough texture to make copper actually look like metal. It’s not some masterpiece, but it’s miles better than what Mojang shipped.

This pack tweaks the copper armor and tools, giving them the texture they should’ve had from the start.
Hopefully, nobody else has to suffer through the original ever again.
